sublists.name: 6 Months to 1 Year Before the Event

items.name: Review Safety Guidelines and Training
items.description: Read the Guide to Safe Scouting. Ensure current training in safety course for your outing.

items.name: Make Site Reservations
items.description: Make site reservations (e.g., State Parks: 6 months in advance at 9am; may need 2nd adult to make reservations simultaneously if group site is not available).

items.name: Deliver Event Details to Scoutmaster
items.description: Provide location, dates, departure/return time & location, cost (extraordinary expenses), uniform requirements (typically Class A travel, Class B camping), and event-specific info.

items.name: Mentor the Scout-in-Charge (SIC)
items.description: As soon as PLC appoints SIC, mentor them as they plan (always cc: parent on electronic communication; biweekly check-ins, meeting prep reminders). Ask SM if unsure who SIC is. Use TWH for email as it automatically copies a parent.

items.name: Promote Event Signups
items.description: Remind SIC to announce outing at troop meetings and encourage signups. Encourage SIC to get creative and put energy into it!

items.name: Adult Leadership & Training Verification
items.description: Identify adult leadership to ensure two-deep leadership throughout (including one female ASM). Ensure adults have required training (YPT, Hazardous Weather, Safe Swim, Safety Afloat, CPR/First Aid, WFA, etc.).

items.name: Weekly SIC Check-in & Equipment Requests
items.description: Check in with SIC weekly. Assist SIC with deciding on needed equipment and submitting requests to the QM.

items.name: When appropriate, remind the SIC to encourage further sign ups.
Follow up on adult leadership if needed.
items.description: Follow up with the adult leaders for the event and make sure they are still available and have completed the apporpriate training.

items.name: Set a sign up deadline on TWH if there is not one already.
items.description: Work with the SIC to determine the best cut off date

items.name: Schedule Pack/Equipment Check
items.description: Schedule equipment checks if necessary. Conduct pack checks with ASMs (can book Summit Room at Sports Basement Sunnyvale or REI Saratoga. Contact the store for more information.).

items.name: Logistics Spreadsheet
items.description: Make a copy of the Logistics Spreadsheet template (from the Troop Google drive) and begin filling out the information.

items.name: Permits, Travel Route & Driver Signups
items.description: Obtain fire permit if required. Start requesting driver signups, plan travel route, and prepare maps/driving instructions for outing day.

items.name: Medical Forms & Roster Preparation
items.description: Unless this is an out of council activity (i.e. Chawanakee) remind parents that we will be using Camp Doc and that their scout’s profile needs to be complete. For outings over 72 hours, they must upload the signed Form C. Check with our medical records volunteer to verify that forms are complete. If paper forms are required, remind parents to fill them out (including Form C if required).

items.name: Aquatics Verification & Church Keys
items.description: Verify scouts participating in Aquatics activities are certified swimmers. Obtain church keys from Scoutmaster if meeting there (to open restrooms and gear storage in room 2).

items.name: Check in with SIC & Driver Communications
items.description: Check in with SIC. Create driver cell phone list and initiate group text.

items.name: First Aid Kit & Adult Food Planning
items.description: Obtain an appropriate First Aid kit (toolbox-size kit in room 2 at church). Coordinate adult food/cooking plan with other adults ('Old Goats').

items.name: Complete and share Logistics Spreadsheet
items.description: Make sure all the information on the Logistics Spreadsheet is complete and share the spreadsheet with the SiC and all adult leaders.

items.name: Attendance & Parent Collection
items.description: Work with SIC to verify presence of RSVP'd scouts (call missing scouts). Collect permission slips, waivers, and printed Medical Forms (A, B1, B2, and Form C if 72+ hours).

items.name: Gear, Fuel & Safety Verification
items.description: Bring printed campfire permit and First Aid kit. Remind SIC to check patrol boxes, gear, and stove fuel.

items.name: Final Departure Checklist
items.description: Ensure all scouts are present/assigned to vehicles, forms collected, and items packed before departure. Distrube parking permits as needed. Coordinate driving directions and driver list.

items.name: Travel & Logistics
items.description: Travel in Class A uniforms. Distribute hiking maps if necessary. Assist as a driver and attend the outing.

items.name: Supervision & Leadership Coaching
items.description: Remind SIC to direct pack lines, fall-ins, campsite selection, and loading/unloading. Monitor headcount, enforce 'Nobody Walks Alone', and take pictures.

items.name: Campfire Participation
items.description: Be prepared with a Scoutmaster minute at the campfire.

items.name: Wrap-Up & Departure Checks
items.description: Ensure SIC completes Leave No Trace sweep before leaving. Remind SIC to close with Roses, Buds, and Thorns. Ensure return travel in Class A uniforms.

items.name: Forms & Media Management
items.description: Return medical forms to scouts. Get shared drive folder link from SM for photo uploads and encourage photo submissions.

items.name: Attendance Tracking
items.description: Update attendance on TWH so scouts receive credit.

items.name: Feedback
items.description: Update outing description on TWH to include any information that would be useful to someone planning the same outing in the future.
